test_title: PYST 63: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends, R, S, V, P and Q, are sitting in a row facing north. Q is sitting to the right of R and left of S. If V is the only one sitting to the left of R, then who is sitting in the left most position?
solution:
Total five friends facing north:- R, S, V, P and Q

1) Q is sitting to the right of R and left of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/297e7fa373f34f02edd42277bc15e3584cabe5394ee632caa12e370090a412c8.png] 

2) If V is the only one sitting to the left of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef2dca1184a08e9977b6ec6a6612a5a30b43eafb2c21b3b9db59525ac05be8c6.png] 

 

Hence, 'V' is sitting in the left most position.
